sources.title: ExVerus: Verus Proof Repair via Counterexample Reasoning
sources.snippet: This paper introduces ExVerus, a system that helps AI models repair failed software proofs by showing them concrete examples of what went wrong. Instead of only reporting that a proof failed, EXVERUS generates specific failing cases, uses them to guide the AI model toward the source of the problem, and then checks the repaired proof again.
